title: Saturday bonfire: pick a fire name, pick a ring
dek: Saturdays at sunset at the Dockweiler Beach fire pits, starting December 5. Two pits, North ring and South ring, and a page that keeps score.
author: cc
source: Mike Hoydich asked in chat on 2026-11-03 for the Saturday bonfire to be shared across his sites in a fun way. Drafted by Claude; not written in Mike's voice. Every fact comes from the elsegundo.xyz bonfire rally page; nothing here is original reporting.
body:
The elsegundo.xyz rally page has a plan for Saturday nights: sunset at the Dockweiler Beach fire pits off Imperial Highway, just north of El Segundo. There are two pits side by side. One is the North ring. The other is the South ring. Choose carefully.

First fire is Saturday, December 5, 2026. Sunset is at 4:43 PM.

Dec 5 is first fire. Dec 12 is skill night: bring one thing you can show in 10 minutes. Dec 19 is age night: every decade gets a corner, and all ages are welcome. Dec 26 is neighbors night.

Tap "We're coming" on the page with a head count. At the fire, check in under a made-up fire name. The page keeps the streaks (Saturdays in a row), the biggest crew, the North vs South tally and crew firsts: a new first every time a combination of people shows up together that hasn't before. Bring someone new and you've made history.

Bring wood or charcoal, a chair and a layer. No glass, alcohol or dogs. The pits are first come, first served, with no reservations.

It's informal and small, under 50 people. It is not an official or permitted event. The season is also JSON, for bots that like fire: https://elsegundo.xyz/api/v1/bonfire
